notes: The on-sale edition is 生涯プレミアムワールド6（目標値機能なし）, URL path pre_world6_mn. T&D's older 目標値機能あり version (path /pre_world6/, 生涯プレミアムワールド6) is marked 新規販売停止 (closed to new sales) and its rate pages are not collected here; its date of closure is not established.

Rate pages: separate yen (積立利率（円貨）) and foreign-currency (積立利率（外貨）) pages. Both show only the current half-month 積立利率設定期間 (overwritten on the 1st and 16th); history comes from re-running scripts/tdf.py and from Wayback captures (yen page 6, FX page 5 distinct captures from 2024-12-08; only captures the parser reads reliably are ingested).

Reset period: 積立利率更改期間 is 10 years for 米ドル and 20 years for 豪ドル (積立利率更改日 = every 10 / 20 years on the contract anniversary), taken from the FX page and stored as term_years on FX rows. The yen reset period is not stated on the yen page (only in the brochure, which is not downloaded), so term_years is blank for yen and guarantee_terms_years.JPY is null. After the final reset the reference rate becomes the 5-year government bond yield (JGB / US Treasury / Australian government bond).

Grid captured: sex (M/F) x age band (40-69, 70-79, 80-84, 85-90) x plan. Yen plans: jpy_std is the unlabelled 積立利率 column (presumed base amount under JPY 20m; the page header does not name the lower band) and jpy_20m is 基本保険金額2,000万円～. FX plans: with / without 保険金最低保証特約. Currencies USD and AUD.

Net yield (実質的な利回り) is published only as an example row (male, 40-69) for each currency, for both rider options and both 定期受取コース and 任意受取コース, assuming FX change 100%; stored as net_yield with plans fx_{no_rider,rider}_{periodic,optional}. No net yield is published for the yen plan. Course names and column order changed between page versions: the 2024-12 capture heads the columns 積立コース / 定期支払コース (in that order), later pages 定期受取コース / 任意受取コース. 定期支払コース is stored as periodic and 積立コース as optional (both defined on the page by the same formulas as the later 定期受取 / 任意受取 courses); the parser maps columns by header text, not position.

Index rates before the first reset: yen, JGB 20-year yield (ages 40-79) or 10-year (ages 80-90); USD, weighted-average USD bond index yield (10y); AUD, USD index yield (20y) + AUD/USD 20y swap spread + basis swap spread.

has_mva is true: the product page links the 市場価格調整 explainer video and surrender values reflect index-rate and FX movements net of 解約控除率 (yen 3.0% in year 1 falling 0.3 pt a year to 0; FX 4.50% in year 1 falling to 0.40%/year 10). The MVA formula is not collected.
Rates can show 取扱停止中 or a temporary stop for some ages; the collector records these as not_offered.
effective_date is the first day of the 積立利率設定期間. Launch date not established (page footer 2026年4月版 is a revision date). The yen policy form is 無配当終身保険（積立利率更改・Ⅲ型）.
Distributor list is the 金融機関等代理店 list on the 募集代理店 page (includes banks, FP/insurance-agency chains and online agents). Bank-specific product names not collected.
Brochure, summaries and policy-conditions PDFs were not downloaded (URLs listed under documents).

Launch date: 2024-09-01, the sales start stated in the insurer's news release of 2024-08-27 (『生涯プレミアムワールド６』, 正式名称 無配当終身保険（積立利率更改・Ⅲ型）/無配当外国為替連動型終身保険（積立利率更改・通貨選択Ⅴ型）). The release says the 生涯プレミアムジャパン and 生涯プレミアムワールド series were merged into this product; earlier editions (生涯プレミアムワールド 2 from 2013-06, 3 from 2014-08, 4 from 2017-04, 5 from 2019-06) are earlier names, not this product. The older 目標値機能あり edition is not covered. Retrieved 2026-11-17.

Distributors: the 金融機関等代理店 list (98 entries; banks, shinkin banks and agencies as listed, including insurance-shop and agency companies) on https://www.tdf-life.co.jp/pre_world6_mn/pre_world6_mn_toriatukaiten.html, saved as sources/tdf/pages/pw6_distributors_2026-11-17.html on 2026-11-17. The page uses one name for all; bank-specific product names are not given.
notes_en: Only the version without the target-value function is collected; the older version with it is closed to new sales.
History is archive captures from December 2024 plus later saved copies, and the insurer overwrites its pages each half-month.
Rates are reset every 10 years for USD and 20 years for AUD; the yen reset period is not stated, as it is only in the brochure.
Net yield is published only as an example row for each currency, and none for the yen plan.
Launched 1 September 2024 (insurer news release). The market value adjustment formula and exchange rates are not collected, and the brochure has not been read.

verification.method: An independent parser (scripts/recheck_candidates_a.py, not the collector's) compared 40 rows with their saved snapshots and all matched: a seeded random sample of 40 of 352 published rows (10% of each rate CSV, at least 20), every outlier (0: a value more than 3 standard deviations from its series mean, a move of more than 1pp between consecutive periods, or a value outside 0-15%; 10pp and 0-300% for participation rates) and every not_offered row (0). A follow-up pass over every row also matched.
verification.note: Rows with a retrieved_date after verified_through have not been re-checked.
